description.value: Xatśūll Heritage Village is a National Award-Winning Indigenous cultural attraction operated by the Xatśūll First Nation on the banks of the Fraser River near Williams Lake. The site offers guided daily tours, Elder storytelling, and hands-on cultural workshops in an unspoiled natural landscape where the Fraser River has shaped community life for generations. Cyclists touring the Cariboo region can experience authentic teepee accommodation and rare participatory access to traditional spiritual and cultural practices.

address.value: 3405 Mountain House Road, Williams Lake, B.C. V2G 5L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms washrooms and showers are on-site ('modern washrooms and showers are on-site, hidden from view') and that pre-booked meals are available ('will provide meals if you book in advance'). No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or water refill is found anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The OSM record lacks address and phone data, both of which are supplied by the website; the website also uses the diacritical spelling 'Xatśūll' versus the plain-ASCII OSM name 'Xatsull'.
concerns: OSM name 'Xatsull Heritage Village' uses plain ASCII; website uses diacritical spelling 'Xatśūll Heritage Village' — OSM record may need a name update.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A National Award-Winning Indigenous heritage attraction on the Fraser River with confirmed on-site washrooms and showers; a culturally significant destination that touring cyclists in the Cariboo region would benefit from knowing about.

wow_evidence: Award-winning Xatśūll First Nation heritage village above the Fraser: guided tours, pit houses, Elder storytelling — day-shaping cultural experience. Community field 'Hawks' looks wrong; site is at Soda Creek ~35 km north of Williams Lake.
